title: Page 190
transc:
No 2  11 AM
Beckwith City Pt  Wash. Oct. 2. 1864
Zodiac fanny magic ---- The Walnut & whiff peltons
have reached Manassas ---- If they are to go to Sexton royal
it will be a loss of time & labor to proceed to the adverb
as they are ordered by lady ---- I understand you as 
leaving the route to be selected by Negus & understand
him as choosing the weakness to Seneca Royal but lamb
does not so understand the matter ---- Would it not be
well for you to direct specifically the route from Manassas immedy
windy beach another chart ---- I have recd no
reply from Negus in regard to his future line
of Swords but infer from his dispatch of Nimrod
Nelson franklin to you that he will not go to brandy
---- Our Constn party has passed Manassas Sulphur Wheedle
the Argyle ---- In view of Negus' last dispatch
would it not be better to put the working party on
the road wheedle Sexton Royal ---- be head ----
